entry.title: The Rat King's Challenge
entry.summary: Talk to the Rat King on floor 5 on your way down and you can challenge him to an optional boss fight. His rats guard him, he calls stampedes and tributes, every blow he lands steals your gold, and at a quarter health he offers you a bribe. Beat him and he pays it all back. The climb back up is tougher and has music on every floor, the soundtrack now loops and fades smoothly, and rankings show each run's skills.

entry.title: Unique Weapons and Armor
entry.summary: Every weapon family now has a unique weapon with its own perk, from Mercy, a dagger that finishes off weakened enemies, to the Gale Crossbow, and every armor family has a unique armor, like the fireproof Ashen Wrap and Gravewrought Plate, which raises the dead to fight for you. Shields are now carried on your arm and can be augmented for more blocking, gloves follow your hands, enemies across the dungeon have been rebalanced, and there's less spare food.

entry.title: Armor Families
entry.summary: Cloth, leather, mail and plate armor each have their own proficiency, trained by the attacks you take. Every family has three passives and an ultimate skill to unlock, and your armor's ultimate sits right at the top when you set up a skill button.

entry.title: A New Hero: the Occultist
entry.summary: The Occultist eats curses. He feeds cursed gear to his Cursed Reliquary to grow stronger, with his own armor abilities, talents and two subclasses, the Hexeater and the Maledict. Find him on the hero select screen.

entry.title: Mimics Learn to Hide
entry.summary: Hidden mimics now use exactly the same art as the chest they imitate, so you'll have to rely on your instincts. All of the dungeon's plants have been redrawn in high detail, music fades smoothly between floors (resuming where it left off), and heroes no longer freeze mid-throw.

entry.title: A New Soundtrack
entry.summary: Every track in the game is new: 31 original pieces covering each region's floors, its danger theme and its bosses, plus the ending and a new main menu theme. Each one is cut to loop seamlessly.

entry.title: The Classic Blacksmith Returns
entry.summary: The troll blacksmith's quest is back to its original form. Borrow his pickaxe and mine dark gold from the glittering veins in the Caves walls, then bring him what you've found.

entry.title: The Dungeon, Redrawn
entry.summary: Every region of the dungeon, from the Sewers to the Demon Halls, has redrawn tiles in the same detailed style as the new heroes and creatures, with seamless floors, still water and new doors.

entry.title: Welcome to Echoes of Yendor
entry.summary: Descend for the Amulet of Yendor with gear forged from metals, weapon proficiency and skills, shields in your off hand, new talents and a fully redrawn world. Open Changes from the main menu for an overview of everything that's different.
